question: Who among the following was one of the defense attorneys of the famous 'Sehgal-Dhillon-Shah Nawaz' trials?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru** was one of the defense attorneys in the famous 'Sehgal-Dhillon-Shah Nawaz' trials.
 
• The trials involved officers of the Indian National Army (INA) who were charged with treason against the British Empire.
 
• Nehru, along with other prominent leaders, took a stand to defend the INA officers, showcasing his commitment to India's independence movement.
 
• The trials garnered significant public attention and were instrumental in galvanizing support for the INA and the broader struggle for independence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Sehgal-Dhillon-Shah Nawaz** trials are also known as the **Red Fort Trials** as they were held at the Red Fort in Delhi.
 
• The trials took place in 1945-46 and were a pivotal moment in the Indian freedom struggle.
 
• These trials highlighted the sacrifices of the INA soldiers and brought to light the atrocities committed by the British colonial authorities.
 
• The defense team also included renowned lawyers like **Bhulabhai Desai** and **Tej Bahadur Sapru**.
 
• The public outcry and nationalist sentiments generated by these trials contributed significantly to the eventual withdrawal of British rule from India.
